summary: Learn to design renewable tenders, govern bid evaluation and negotiate PPA terms. Explore the course and strengthen buyer-side contract practice.
lede: Renewable energy procurement training helps public buyers, utility teams and advisers shape solar, wind and hybrid-power tenders. It builds skills in drafting tender and evaluation documents, comparing bids against stated criteria, and allocating project and payment risks. Participants also review bankability questions, negotiate power-purchase agreement terms, and prepare traceable award and contract-oversight records using evaluation matrices and risk registers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who shape or scrutinize public tenders and contracts for solar, wind and hybrid power projects, including those who advise the buyer or submit project proposals.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to public procurement, utility commercial work, infrastructure project development or contract administration is recommended. No coding or specialist modelling software is required; exercises use tender artefacts and spreadsheet-based comparisons.
